$comment: FleetLink project settings (Module 2.F). The hook below is the deterministic half of the consistency toolkit: it runs on EVERY Edit/Write/MultiEdit, before the write lands, and blocks anything that looks like a secret or a connection string (the CLAUDE.md sandbox rule). Standards drift (layering, naming, magic-int enums) is handled by the /standards-check command and the standards-reviewer subagent — this hook is only for the must-never-happen. Node is used (not bash) so it runs the same on Windows, macOS and Linux.
